gpu_probe.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

hypothesis: A pilot-proxy regime-aware selector that chooses independent estimation in negative CATE-error correlation regimes and partial-pooling otherwise can improve downstream CATE RMSE win rate over fixed partial-pooling and fixed independent across the e008 DGP grid, while retaining partial-pooling gains in high-severity positive-correlation cells.

selector_rules.oracle_regime_selector: Upper bound that chooses the lower realized CATE RMSE between partial_pooling and independent within each replication; it is not deployable.
selector_rules.pilot_corr_selector: Estimate independent row-wise error rates from finite expert labels; estimate preliminary subgroup CATE magnitudes from observed noisy labels; choose independent if corr(error_proxy, abs(observed_tau)) < -0.10, otherwise choose partial_pooling.
selector_rules.pilot_corr_severity_selector: Use the same proxy correlation plus max estimated row error as severity proxy; choose independent if proxy corr < -0.20, or if proxy corr < -0.10 and max estimated row error < 0.25; otherwise choose partial_pooling, preserving high-severity nonnegative-correlation partial-pooling behavior.
